nodes.description: Address holding the governance role; set to msg.sender in the constructor and updatable via setGovernance.
Constant maximum token supply (354786434702574732562458800) minted to governance at deployment.
Mapping of owner address to ERC2612 permit nonce counters used by permit and nonces.
EIP712 domain separator computed in the ERC20Permit constructor for signature verification.
Ownable owner storage variable used by the onlyOwner modifier.

Governance-only setter that overwrites the governance address.
Governance-only function that transfers arbitrary tokens out of the contract to a destination address.
EIP2612 permit implementation validating a deadline and an ECDSA signature to set an allowance.

Miner-influenced timestamp compared against the permit deadline.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the governance state variable, granting full control to the deployer.
setGovernance is gated by the onlyGovernance modifier which compares msg.sender against the governance address.
recoverToken is gated by the onlyGovernance modifier validating msg.sender.
The governance state variable is read in the onlyGovernance check guarding setGovernance.
The governance state variable is read in the onlyGovernance check guarding recoverToken.
The constructor writes msg.sender into the governance state variable.
The constructor mints the MAX_CAP constant to governance.
permit compares block.timestamp against the caller-supplied deadline, creating a timestamp dependency.
permit reads and increments the _nonces counter of the owner to build the digest.
permit uses the DOMAIN_SEPARATOR to build the EIP712 digest.
permit passes the computed digest and v/r/s into ecrecover.
recoverToken performs the external token transfer before verifying the transfer result, allowing reentrant execution.
The external call to an arbitrary token contract can re-enter recoverToken.
The token parameter is used directly as the call target for the external transfer.
The destination parameter flows into the external token transfer call.
The amount parameter flows into the external token transfer call.
The _governance parameter is written into the governance state variable in setGovernance.
The owner parameter is part of the signed permit digest and allowance approval.
The spender parameter is part of the signed permit digest and allowance approval.
The amount parameter is part of the signed permit digest and allowance approval.
The deadline parameter is compared with block.timestamp in permit.
The v signature parameter is forwarded to ecrecover in permit.
The r signature parameter is forwarded to ecrecover in permit.
The s signature parameter is forwarded to ecrecover in permit.
nonces reads the _nonces counter mapping for the given owner.
